answer: Each timber is one fake identity. Each relic is one identity-bound, judge-signed receipt for completed judged work. A nebula is the registry: it charges each newcomer in a fork one relic per member of the resulting lineage, and one global judge certifies only one receipt per epoch. A thousand clones need a thousand receipts each, costing a million elapsed epochs; receipts cannot be shared or split. A corrupted judge breaks it.
